```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == "notebooks" else Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))

import pandas as pd
from youbike import load_rentals, prepare_stations, add_trip_features, station_match_report

RAW = ROOT / "data" / "raw"
EXTERNAL = ROOT / "data" / "external"
PROCESSED = ROOT / "data" / "processed"
```

## 讀取租借紀錄

先執行 `python scripts/download_data.py --month 2026-03` 下載資料到 `data/raw/`。

```{python}
files = sorted(RAW.glob("*.csv"))
trips = load_rentals(files)
print(f"讀入 {len(trips):,} 筆，刪除 {trips.attrs['n_dropped']:,} 筆無效紀錄")
trips.head()
```

## 車種分布

```{python}
trips["bike_type"].value_counts().to_frame("n").assign(share=lambda d: d["n"] / d["n"].sum())
```

```{python}
n_all = trips["rent_station"].nunique()
n_ebike = trips.loc[trips["bike_type"] == "ebike", "rent_station"].nunique()
print(f"站點數：{n_all}，有電輔車借出的站點：{n_ebike}")
```

## 站名比對

```{python}
stations = prepare_stations(pd.read_csv(EXTERNAL / "stations.csv"))
missing = station_match_report(trips, stations)
print(f"對不上的站名：{len(missing)} 個，涉及 {missing['n_trips'].sum():,} 筆旅次")
missing.head(20)
```

## 旅次特徵

```{python}
trips_f = add_trip_features(trips, stations)
trips_f[["distance_km", "duration_min", "speed_kmh", "hour", "day_type"]].describe(include="all")
```

```{python}
PROCESSED.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
trips_f.to_parquet(PROCESSED / "trips.parquet", index=False)
```
